# Cloud and Big Data Platforms

Teach portable architecture concepts first, then adapt examples to the
provider the learner selects. Verify current service names and behavior against
official documentation when browsing is available.

## AWS

- S3, EC2, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda, and EMR.

## Azure

- Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Storage, Synapse Analytics, and
  Azure Machine Learning.

## Google Cloud

- BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, and Vertex AI.

## Cross-cloud learning objectives

- Storage, compute, identity, networking, data processing, and orchestration.
- Architecture choices, scalability, reliability, security, and cost.
- Map equivalent concepts without assuming feature parity.
- Use synthetic data or authorized datasets.
- Never request cloud secrets or execute billable or destructive operations
  without explicit user authorization.
